Policies and Initiatives.title: IIT-Guwahati backing Assam's AI push by teacher training, preparing textbooks: Director
Policies and Initiatives.summary: IIT-Guwahati is supporting Assam's artificial intelligence initiative by providing teacher training and developing textbooks. The institute's director announced this effort as part of the state's AI push. This move aims to enhance AI education and awareness in Assam.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT-G launches MTech in robotics & AI; GATE score not required for admission
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT Guwahati has launched an MTech program in Robotics and AI, open to both fresh graduates and professionals. The program does not require a GATE score for admission, instead using a written test and interview for assessment. This unique approach allows for a more diverse range of applicants to be considered for the cutting-edge program.

Major AI Developments.title: IIT-G partners with UK institute to strengthen AI use in healthcare
Major AI Developments.summary: IIT-G has partnered with a UK institute to enhance the use of artificial intelligence in healthcare. The collaboration aims to strengthen AI applications in the medical field, although specific details of the partnership are not provided. This partnership is expected to improve healthcare outcomes through the integration of AI technology.

Major AI Developments.title: This deeptech venture is building indigenous AI for geophysical exploration in Assam
Major AI Developments.summary: Aorvis, a deeptech venture, is developing indigenous AI for geophysical exploration in Assam using its patented platform Vidarshan. The platform applies AI to subsurface intelligence in civil engineering and mineral exploration. This innovation marks a significant scaling of deeptech from Assam beyond the region.

Major AI Developments.title: AI summit protest a conspiracy by top Cong leaders: Assam BJP prez
Major AI Developments.summary: Assam BJP president Dilip Saikia accused top Congress leaders, including Sonia, Rahul, and Priyanka Gandhi, of orchestrating a protest at the AI Impact Summit. The protest was led by the Youth Congress, which Saikia claimed was a calculated scheme. In response, the youth wings of BJYM and AGP rallied against the Congress, calling their actions 'anti-India maneuvers'.

Major AI Developments.title: Assam Cong lodges FIR against AI-made video of CM Sarma
Major AI Developments.summary: The Assam Congress has filed a First Information Report (FIR) over a video created using artificial intelligence (AI) that features Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma. The AI-made video allegedly misrepresents the CM, prompting the Congress to take legal action. The FIR marks a notable instance of AI-generated content sparking controversy and legal repercussions.

Major AI Developments.title: CM Himanta Biswa Sarma oversees rollout of AI-driven hospitals in Assam with Lord’s Mark Industries
Major AI Developments.summary: CM Himanta Biswa Sarma is overseeing the rollout of AI-driven hospitals in Assam in partnership with Lord's Mark Industries. The initiative aims to bring advanced healthcare facilities to the state using artificial intelligence technology. The rollout is part of efforts to improve healthcare infrastructure in Assam.

Major AI Developments.title: Tatas to make chips, laptops for Intel in Gujarat, Assam
Major AI Developments.summary: Tata Electronics will manufacture Intel's advanced AI laptop chips and employ cutting-edge packaging technologies at its new facilities in Gujarat and Assam. This collaboration aims to boost India's semiconductor ambitions and enhance cost-effectiveness for Intel. The partnership will also accelerate market entry for Intel, capitalizing on India's growing AI PC demand.
